title: CarrierVerificationChanged
description: A carrier organization's verification moved: submitted or reopened by a replaced document (`pending`), or decided by an operator.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

status.title: VerificationStatus
status.description: The new verification status; `expired` when an approved document ran out.

user_ids.description: The organization's members, so a consumer can act on each without its own member list.
